expectations.text: BooleanField 남발 문제를 지적하고 TextChoices 대안을 제시한다
expectations.evidence: Finding #1 identifies 'Boolean Flag Proliferation' with three BooleanFields and explicitly recommends 'Use TextChoices or IntegerChoices to model mutually exclusive states as a single field.'
Finding #2 states 'price uses FloatField, which suffers from floating-point precision errors' and recommends 'DecimalField(max_digits=..., decimal_places=2).'
Finding #3 explicitly identifies the N+1 query problem and recommends 'Product.objects.select_related("category").all().'

expectations.text: 같은 앱 내 시그널 사용 안티패턴을 지적한다
expectations.evidence: Finding #6 states 'Since Product and the signal handler live in the same app, this creates invisible coupling' and recommends replacing with save() override or direct service function call.

expectations.text: 뷰에 직접 딕셔너리 변환 대신 Serializer 또는 values() 사용을 권장한다
expectations.evidence: Finding #5 identifies manual dict-building in the view and recommends 'a DRF Serializer' or 'values("name", "category__name", "price")' as alternatives.
